notes.title: Karate Survivor is out now!
notes.content:
Are you ready to unleash your inner martial arts master? Karate Survivor is live, ready to throw you into the gritty, fast-paced world of 80s street brawls! 

In this survivor-like roguelite, every corner of the city is your battleground. Fend off relentless thugs using fists, feet, and anything you can get your hands on – from mop handles to plastic flamingos! Your surroundings are part of your arsenal. Push over scaffolding, swing microwave doors, and turn the world into a weapon. 

[previewyoutube=WH_KjiLuvMg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What awaits you in Karate Survivor: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Improvised Combat:[/b] Use whatever you can get your hands on to dismantle your enemies. Even a toy hammer can be lethal! 
[*][b] Environmental Warfare: [/b]Manipulate the streets to your advantage. Push objects at enemies, bring down scaffolding, or slam them with a microwave door. 
[*] [b]Dynamic Combos: [/b]Mix and match dozens of attacks into unique six-move combos. Find the most devastating combos to suit your style. 
[*] [b]Progression and Mastery: [/b]Unlock and master techniques that stay with you across runs. Every fight brings you closer to martial arts mastery. 
[*] [b]Fast-paced Runs and Boss Battles: [/b]Face fierce bosses across gritty locations in epic, high-speed showdowns. 
[/list]
Also, we’ll be adding a new challenge mode as a New Game+ with increased difficulty in an upcoming post-release patch for those eager to test their skills. 

Stay tuned and grab Karate Survivor now with a 10% launch discount. Don’t forget to leave a review to support us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

notes.title: First Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
We’re excited to bring you the first update for Technotopia, focused on enhancing gameplay and fixing some key issues. Please ensure you have the latest version (1.0.4) installed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890966/4319ab63a0126bf1753542a82f512a42c7326b2f.png[/img]

[b]List of changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented several minor code tweaks aimed at improving gameplay. 
[*] Fixed some issues related to save profiles. 
[*] Resolved a graphical artifact in the final cutscene. 
[*] Updated the font on the “Create” button for an empty profile. 
[*] Changed the Excavator building icon. 
[/list]
[b]Known issues: [/b]

We’ve noticed that some players are experiencing crashes, which seem to be related to insufficient RAM. We're actively working on a solution. In the meantime, here are the recommended system requirements: 

OS: Windows 10 64-bit   
Processor: Intel(R) Core (TM) i5-4440 CPU / AMD Ryzen 5 1600   
Memory: 8 GB RAM   
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 760   
Storage: 3 GB available space   

[b]If you’ve encountered this issue, please send the following data to our support team [url=https://support.alawar.com/technotopia]via bug report form[/url]: [/b]
[olist]
[*] Save files and logs located at C:\Users\...\AppData\LocalLow\Yustas Games Studio 
[*] Dxdiag:  Press Start in Windows, type "dxdiag" in the search box, and select it from the results. Choose “Save all information” in the tool. 
[/olist]
We also recommend closing other applications, like browsers, to free up memory and avoid crashes. 

Thank you for your feedback and continued support as we work to improve Technotopia! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825110/Technotopia/

notes.title: Technotopia is Now Available!
notes.content:
The wait is over – [b]Technotopia is finally available![/b] The city of the future awaits, and it’s your time to take control. 

As the AI Iris, you are tasked with creating the perfect city in a world fractured by social and economic unrest. The metropolis teeters on the edge of chaos, and the balance between competing factions is fragile. Every decision you make will shape the fate of Technotopia – will you build a utopia, or let the city descend into turmoil? 

[previewyoutube=8ZPQsLAHWfg;full][/previewyoutube]

What awaits you in Technotopia: 
[list]
[*] 4 Faction-Driven Questlines: Capitalists, aristocrats, politicians, and common citizens all want control of the city. Navigate their conflicting agendas and choose your allies wisely – each storyline will alter the city’s future. 
[*] 100+ Unique Buildings: Construct skyscrapers, parks, residential zones, and industrial hubs. Every building you place will influence the balance of power, helping or hindering different factions. Strategically combine city blocks to maximize efficiency and unlock special bonuses. 
[*] 50+ Dynamic Events: From everyday mishaps to faction conflicts, every event in Technotopia is shaped by your choices, with consequences that ripple across the city. 
[*] Factions' Influence: Every decision shifts the delicate balance between the city’s ruling groups. Will you appease the elites, or side with the people? 
[*] City News & Criminal Activity: As crime rises, new challenges emerge, forcing you to make tough decisions. Stay informed through real-time news reports that reflect the impact of your actions on the city's order. 
[/list]
Get the game with a [b]10% launch discount[/b] and share your feedback on Technotopia – we’re excited to hear your thoughts! Join our Discord to stay up to date on the latest news. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825110/Technotopia/

notes.title: Update on Technotopia Release Date
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

We have an update on Technotopia launch date on Steam: the game is now set to release on [b]October 23rd[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890966/bde3c8eca75c25e17c7a1a65d7b1766c73932542.png[/img]

Postponing the launch was not an easy decision for us but we have important reasons to do so. Firstly, our team needs a little bit more time to fix the last bugs – we don’t want to release a product that doesn’t meet our quality standards or has issues that could ruin your experience. Secondly, we want to make sure there are no localization errors, as the game is text-heavy. 

Apologies for the delay. We promise that the extra time will be well spent, and the final version will be worth the wait! 

Thank you for your continued support and patience — we really appreciate it! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825110/Technotopia/

notes.title: Playtest results and plans
notes.content:
The Technotopia playtest has concluded, and we are ready to share our future plans with you! 

We would like to thank everyone who participated in our game's playtest: your feedback, comments, and ideas for improvement were invaluable and very useful to us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890966/3df58843f888fb3b61b3dd3f9be044916b3c9a22.png[/img]

After carefully reviewing everything, we are ready to unveil the upcoming changes: 

[list]
[*] More buildings. Now you will have more different options for city development! 
[*] More events. The situations in your city will become even more diverse and interesting! 
[*] More tasks. You will have more options for interacting with factions to immerse yourself even deeper into the world of your future city. 
[*] Iris's story continuation. Expect even more revelations about the artificial intelligence you control. 
[*] New animations and UI improvements. 
[*] New buildings shape options and revised ways for earning faction points through their construction.  
[*] A section for city news that will reflect past events and the consequences of your choices. 
[*] In-game tooltips for factions, decks, events, and building shapes. 
[*] Updated tutorial. It will be more coherent and structured. 
[/list]
We also have exciting news for you: the Technotopia demo will take part in [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] this June. Soon, you will be able to try out all the new features.  

To stay updated on all the news, make sure Technotopia is on your wishlist! Additionally, join our [url=https://discord.gg/ alawar]Discord[/url] server to connect with other fans! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825110/Technotopia/

notes.title: Technotopia – Build a Better Tomorrow, Today!
notes.content:
All systems are set up. Initiating city-building procedures in Technotopia – the roguelite card game. Take on the role of an AI tasked with building a perfect city amidst the conditions of a global economic crisis. Keep an eye on city life, manage factions, fulfill the needs of diverse communities, strive to maintain the balance, and work towards creating a utopian future for humankind! 

[previewyoutube=TpNcRsFrcA0;full][/previewyoutube] 

[b]As AI Iris, you will: [/b]
[list]
[*] Manage the deck of cards with buildings at your disposal. Use the cards to build skyscrapers, parks, residential districts, and transportation highways.
[*] Distribute the influence among four factions: capitalists, aristocrats, politicians, and the common people, who are fighting to establish their authority and control over the city. Try to maintain the balance needed for a truly perfect city.
[*] Address the random events that could be triggered by constructing buildings, such as fires, gangs that have taken control of some districts, and the processes of city life. Listen to the factions to solve urban problems, but be wary of the consequences.
[/list]
Follow and wishlist Technotopia to receive major data updates on development progress on time:
